```{r}
# Make sure dplyr is loaded
library(dplyr)
library(reshape2)
library(tidyr)

alldata <- readRDS("C:/rprojects/stormsevaluation/data/storms_eval.rds")


#' Calculate Detailed Pairwise Rater Agreement
#'
#' This function calculates both the percent agreement and the number of common
#' comparisons for each pair of raters across a list of data frames.
#'
#' @param df_list A list of data frames.
#' @param id_col A character string for the name of the item identifier column.
#'
#' @return A list containing two matrices:
#'         - `agreement`: Pairwise percent agreement.
#'         - `counts`: Number of items rated in common by each pair.
#'
calculate_pairwise_agreement_detailed <- function(df_list, id_col) {
  # Combine all data frames from the list into a single data.frame
  combined_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_list) %>% select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))
  
  # Determine how many raters we have
  raters <- setdiff(names(combined_df), id_col)

  if (length(raters) < 2) {
    stop("Fewer than two rater columns found.")
  }

  # Create empty matrices for results
  num_raters <- length(raters)
  agreement_matrix <- comparison_counts <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = num_raters,
    ncol = num_raters,
    dimnames = list(raters, raters)
  )

  # Get all unique pairs
  rater_pairs <- combn(raters, 2, simplify = FALSE)

  for (pair in rater_pairs) {
    rater1 <- pair[1]
    rater2 <- pair[2]

    # Isolate data for the pair and remove rows with NAs
    complete_cases <- na.omit(combined_df[, c(rater1, rater2)])
    num_comparisons <- nrow(complete_cases)

    if (num_comparisons > 0) {
      agreement <- sum(complete_cases[[1]] == complete_cases[[2]]) / num_comparisons
    } else {
      agreement <- NA_real_
    }

    # Store results symmetrically
    agreement_matrix[rater1, rater2] <- agreement_matrix[rater2, rater1] <- agreement
    comparison_counts[rater1, rater2] <- comparison_counts[rater2, rater1] <- num_comparisons
  }

  # Diagonals
  diag(agreement_matrix) <- 1.0
  diag(comparison_counts) <- NA # A rater doesn't have a "pair count" with themselves

  return(list(agreement = agreement_matrix, counts = comparison_counts))
}
```

```{r}
detailed_results <- calculate_pairwise_agreement_detailed(df_list = alldata, id_col = "Number")
agreement_matrix <- detailed_results$agreement
counts_matrix <- detailed_results$counts

front_names <- c("AC", "GG", "OC")

# Get all column names from one of the matrices
all_names <- colnames(agreement_matrix)

# Create the new order: front_names followed by all other names
new_order <- c(front_names, setdiff(all_names, front_names))

# Apply this new order to both the rows and columns of each matrix
agreement_matrix <- agreement_matrix[new_order, new_order]
counts_matrix <- counts_matrix[new_order, new_order]
```

```{r}
# --- Calculate Weighted Average Agreement ---
raters <- rownames(agreement_matrix)
weighted_avg <- numeric(length(raters))
names(weighted_avg) <- raters

for (rater in raters) {
  # Get the agreement scores and counts for this rater's pairs
  agreements <- agreement_matrix[rater, ]
  counts <- counts_matrix[rater, ]

  # Calculate the weighted average, ignoring NA values
  total_weighted_agreement <- sum(agreements * counts, na.rm = TRUE)
  total_counts <- sum(counts, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (total_counts > 0) {
    weighted_avg[rater] <- total_weighted_agreement / total_counts
  } else {
    weighted_avg[rater] <- NA
  }
}
```

```{r}
# --- Generate the Complex Heatmap ---

# First, ensure packages are installed and loaded
# install.packages("ComplexHeatmap")
# install.packages("circlize")
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

# 1. Prepare annotation data
ai_raters <- c("GG", "AC", "OC")
rater_type <- ifelse(raters %in% ai_raters, "AI Rater", "Human Rater")

annotation_df <- data.frame(
  Type = rater_type,
  WeightedAvg = weighted_avg
)



# 2. Define colors
type_colors <- c("AI Rater" = "#1f77b4", "Human Rater" = "#ff7f0e")
avg_color_fun <- colorRamp2(c(min(weighted_avg, na.rm=T), max(weighted_avg, na.rm=T)), c("white", "purple"))
heatmap_color_fun <- colorRamp2(c(0, 0.5, 1), c("tomato", "white", "steelblue"))

# 3. Create the annotation object
ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  df = annotation_df,
  col = list(Type = type_colors, WeightedAvg = avg_color_fun),
  annotation_legend_param = list(
     WeightedAvg = list(title = "Weighted Avg.")
  )
)

# 4. Draw the heatmap
ht <- Heatmap(
  agreement_matrix,
  name = "Agreement", # Legend title for the heatmap
  col = heatmap_color_fun,

  # Add the annotation bar to the top
  top_annotation = ha,

  # Split columns based on rater type to group them
  column_split = annotation_df$Type,
  column_title = "Rater Groups",

  # Display the agreement values in the cells
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if(!is.na(agreement_matrix[i, j])) {
      grid.text(sprintf("%.2f", agreement_matrix[i, j]), x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 10))
    }
  },

  # Keep original ordering
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  
  # Aesthetics
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "grey", lwd = 1)
)

# Draw the plot in the viewer
draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom", annotation_legend_side = "bottom", merge_legend = TRUE)
```
